## 4.CV Lasso

```{r}
model_lasso <- train(medv ~ ., 
                     data = data, 
                     method = "glmnet", 
                     preProcess = c("center", "scale"), 
                     metric = "RMSE",
                     maximize = F,
                     trControl = ctrl, 
                     tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 1,
                                            lambda = parameters))


model_lasso$results %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lambda, y = RMSE)) + 
  geom_line(col = "grey55") + 
  geom_point(size = 1, col = "green") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = model_lasso[["bestTune"]][["lambda"]], 
             col = "red",linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = min(model_lasso[["results"]][["RMSE"]]),
             col = "deepskyblue3",linetype="dashed")+
  labs(title = "Boston Dataset - Lasso Regression", 
       subtitle = "Selecting shrinkage parameter with Repeated k-fold cross-validation",
       y = "CV RMSE",
       x = "λ")+
  theme_minimal()
```

### 4.1 Best Lasso by CV

```{r}
# coefficents  L1 norm & lambda
plot(model_lasso$finalModel, label = T, lwd = 2)+
legend("bottomright", lwd = 1, col = 1:13, legend = colnames(newx), cex = .6)

plot(model_lasso$finalModel, xvar="lambda",label = T, lwd = 2)+
legend("bottomright", lwd = 1, col = 1:13, legend = colnames(newx), cex = .6)

# Best lambda 
lassolambda = model_lasso$bestTune$lambda

#  importance plot variables
plot(varImp(model_lasso,scale=TRUE,lambda = lassolambda))

# predict from train object
predLasso = predict.train(model_lasso,fitbest = TRUE)

# predicted vs observed
data.frame(predLasso,data$medv)%>%
ggplot(aes(y = data$medv, x = predLasso)) +          
           geom_point() +      
           geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
                       color = "red", size = .8)+
  ggtitle("Lasso: Predicted Vs Observed")+
  xlab("Observed")+
  ylab("Predicted")+
  theme_minimal()
```
